title: MIL-101-SO3H: functionalized MOF for enhanced barium ion adsorption and environmental remediation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13525-13538
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01671A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abouzar Tahkor, Seyed Dariush Taherzade, Niloufar Akbarzadeh, Alireza Rezvani, Janet Soleimannejad
Sulfonic acid-functionalized MIL-101 exhibits 163% higher barium adsorption (141.9 vs. 54 mg g−1) than pristine MIL-101, demonstrating enhanced water remediation via strong sulfonate-barium coordination.
